title: kate-ui: paint the selection in the theme selection color
summary: The selection quad uses Theme::selection_color. The IME mark keeps TextSelection. The test builds only on macOS. macos-15 runs it.

lane.reason: paint.rs compiles only on macOS. The regression test is cfg target_os macos. The macos-15 job runs it. A Linux agent cannot compile this file.

definitions.definition:
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub(crate) struct Colors {
    pub background: Hsla,
    pub foreground: Hsla,
    pub gutter: Hsla,
    pub gutter_text: Hsla,
    pub current_line: Hsla,
    pub marked: Hsla,
    pub selection: Hsla,
}

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Colors gains selection. colors_from_theme sets selection from Theme::selection_color. paint_line_selections uses that field. marked stays the IME color from TextSelection. The test function has cfg(target_os = macos). paint.rs is already cfg macos. Linux CI does not compile this file. The macos-15 job runs the test. This packet does not enable the gpui-tests feature. regression_tests.name: paint::tests::selection_uses_the_theme_selection_color
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because Colors has no selection field. The test has cfg(target_os = macos). The theme sets background and TextSelection to #94CAEF. selection_color is the second blue. colors_from_theme.selection matches that color. marked still matches TextSelection.
